course-day0:en-US-ga.subject: Your first American English listening challenge
course-day0:en-US-ga.text:
Hi,

It's Micheal. Thanks for joining the American English listening course!

Let’s start with ship and sheep. The sound categories to listen for are /ɪ/ and /i/.

Listen to the examples in the guide, then try a few rounds in practice with the words hidden. Keep listening for the target sound as the words change. You can replay the audio as much as you need.

If something sounds confusing, hit reply and tell me. I'm actively working on the product and I'd like to know what would help you.

Thanks,
Micheal

Hear ship and sheep: https://minimalpairs.co/learn/en-i-ih
